decisions.rationale: The USGS original contains one approved daily mean per station on each of the three local dates. Its ft³/s values reproduce all six rates and their 25% allowances in the calculation record. Multiplication by 86,400 seconds per day gives a native-unit cross-check of 3,594,240 and 3,240,000 ft³, with a signed difference of +354,240 ft³ and a range from −1,354,320 to +2,062,800 ft³. The concurrent method can verify duration and litre totals on this pair.
